title: 第5章 表姑娘真的出事了吗？(2)

content_zh:
其中一个黑衣人满意的压低声音道：“走吧，这个贱人就算不摔死也能冻死，死了倒好，罪有应得，也不看看谁都敢得罪，呸！”
这两人还将那个已经坏了的随风椅，噼啪几下子给劈成了木材碎片，再也无法恢复原样，最后匆匆消失在夜色中。
房顶上的俊美男子制止了两个随从想跟踪看看的意思，只让一个随便过去看看即可，然后在看看雪地冰冻荷花池里面的女子，然后斯文的声音响起道：“去引来一个人吧，毕竟是一条生命！她这个地方也算是救了咱们一回，咱们就当日行一善吧。”
随从被说得差点从房顶上栽下去，公子会日行一善？
随从一下子就没影了一个，其实这个斯文的男子许是看见了从这个女子衣襟中掉出来的那抹翠绿了，他这个人心情一好就做了善事。
随从走后，没过一刻钟就出现了一个提着灯笼的女孩子，轻声的喊着：“慧姐，慧姐，这么晚了你去哪里了？屋子里面也没有，这么冷的天也不怕着凉，慧姐你在哪里？”
这个女子就是二房的姑娘卢代菡，不知道为何今晚心神不宁，想到下午见到慧姐失魂落魄的模样，就跟当初二姑姑去世时候一个样子，她就不放心，避开了二房守门的婆子，谁都没带自己悄悄的溜了出来。
结果到了清花阁，里面一个人都没有，在进了慧姐的房间，这么晚了竟然慧姐不在，代菡一下子就急了，莫不是长房大哥已经定亲的消息被慧姐知道了，这下子惨了，慧姐千万不要想不开。
代菡急慌慌的从房间走了出来，正急着该从哪里去寻找，就在这时一个石子落地的声音从月亮门那里发出来，代菡眼前一亮，对啊慧姐平时最喜欢的地方不就是那个随风椅吗？
代菡急急的走着，结果到了地方，那颗大树下，空空如也椅子也成了碎片，地上都被砸了一个坑，代菡的灯笼一下子掉在了地上，惊慌的喊道：“慧姐你在哪里，慧姐你在哪里？慧姐你千万不要出事，千万不要出事啊。”
代菡惊慌的在随风椅周围寻找，结果什么都没找到，代菡急的都哭了道：“慧姐，你不要出事，小时候二姑姑对我最好了，虽然二姑姑不在了，但是我会保护你的，你在哪里，不要和代菡姐姐玩闹了，快点出来，出来啊！”
代菡将这周围都找遍了，根本没有，代菡焦急万分，嘴里念念叨叨的希望慧姐没事，然后听见荷花池有声响动，结果在看向荷花池的瞬间，感觉浑身的血液都冻住了，那个泥浆浆的人是慧姐吗？
代菡也顾不得会脏污了自己的衣衫，连滚带爬的下去了，看着昏迷的慧姐，赶快抱着道：“慧姐你怎么了？这是出什么事情了？啊血这么多的血，来人啊，慧姐出事了，快来人啊！”
“快来人啊，慧姐出事了，快来人啊，救命啊！”
深夜的卢家这惊慌的声音传出去老远，很快几个院子的灯就亮了起来，可是听着是慧姐出事了，有几处的灯就熄了，代菡心都凉了半截，这会子只能继续喊：“快来人啊，慧姐出事了，快来人啊，救命啊！”
代菡拼着自己的力气，慢慢的将慧姐往外挪，可是收效甚微，这时候听见动静的秀雁和青杏衣衫都没穿好，就出来了，这下子房顶上的几个人才嗖的一下离开，并没有惊动任何人！
秀雁看到这家小姐这样，腿都软了，代菡道：“秀雁赶快去叫人，找大夫，快去啊。”
秀雁这才去找卢家的人帮忙，这么一来，整个一晚上，清花阁都灯火通明……
清晨，阳光洒在冰冷的石阶上，平日这个时辰仁安伯府各院的主子们应该起床用早膳了，也是一天中比较热闹的时候，可今个府里确出奇的十分安静。
闹腾了一夜的长房主子们和奴才都有些蔫蔫的，或许是昨晚清花阁那场惊心动魄吓坏了好些人呢！

如今仁安伯府老夫人去了京郊的慈云庵茹素祈福，这一走就是四个月，据说年底的时候会回来，而目前卢家的当家的人自然是卢家的长房的大老爷和大夫人。
许是因为老夫人目前不在府里，而叶表姑娘出了这样的大事，这长房难辞其咎，所以卢家长房的几个主子们，皆因昨晚上叶表姑娘差点丧命而惶有些恐不安。

content_en:
One of the men in black lowered his voice with satisfaction and said: "Let's go, this bitch will freeze to death even if she doesn't fall to death. It would be better if she died. She deserves it, and she doesn't dare to offend anyone, bah!"
The two men also smashed the broken wind chair into pieces of wood, which could never be restored to their original shape, and finally disappeared into the night in a hurry.
The handsome man on the roof stopped the two followers who wanted to follow her, and only let one of them go over and take a look. Then he looked at the woman in the frozen lotus pond on the snow, and then a gentle voice said: "Go and attract someone, after all, it is a life! She can be regarded as saving us once, so let's do a good deed that day."
The entourage almost fell off the roof after being told this. Will the young master do one good deed every day?
The entourage suddenly disappeared. In fact, this gentle man may have seen the emerald green that fell out of the woman's skirt. He is a man who does good deeds when he is in a good mood.
After the entourage left, a girl holding a lantern appeared within a quarter of an hour, calling softly: "Sister Hui, Sister Hui, where have you been so late? There is no one in the house. It's such a cold day and I'm not afraid of catching a cold. Sister Hui, where are you?"
This woman was Lu Daihan, the girl from the second room. She didn't know why she was restless tonight. She thought about seeing Sister Hui in the afternoon looking like a lost soul, just like when her second aunt died. She felt uneasy and avoided the mother-in-law who was guarding the door of the second room. She slipped out quietly without anyone.
As a result, when they arrived at Qinghua Pavilion, there was no one inside. After entering Sister Hui's room, she was not there at such a late hour. Dai Han suddenly became anxious. Could it be that the news that the eldest brother had been engaged was known to Sister Hui. This was a terrible situation. Sister Hui must not let it go unthinking.
Dai Han hurriedly walked out of the room and was anxious about where to look. At this moment, the sound of a pebble falling to the ground came from the moon door. Dai Han's eyes lit up. Yes, isn't Sister Hui's favorite place the most? That wind chair?
Dai Han walked hurriedly, but when he arrived at the place, under the big tree, the empty chairs were broken into pieces, and a hole was smashed on the ground. Dai Han's lantern suddenly fell to the ground, and he shouted in panic: "Sister Hui, where are you, Sister Hui, where are you? Sister Hui, please don't get into trouble, don't get into trouble."
Dai Han searched around the wind chair in panic, but found nothing. Dai Han was so anxious that he cried: "Sister Hui, don't let anything happen to you. My second aunt was the best to me when I was a child. Although my second aunt is gone, I will protect you. Where are you? Stop playing around with Sister Dai Han. Come out quickly, come out!"
Dai Han searched all around, but there was nothing there. Dai Han was extremely anxious and muttered the hope that Sister Hui would be fine. Then he heard a noise in the lotus pond. As a result, when he looked at the lotus pond, he felt that the blood all over his body was frozen. Is the person slurping in the mud Sister Hui?
Dai Han didn't care about soiling his clothes, and rolled down. Looking at the unconscious Sister Hui, he quickly hugged her and said, "Sister Hui, what's wrong with you? What's going on? There's so much blood, someone, come on, something happened to Sister Hui, come on!"
"Someone, come quickly, something happened to Sister Hui. Come, someone, help!"
The panicked sound of the Lu family in the middle of the night spread far and wide, and soon the lights in several courtyards turned on. But it sounded like something had happened to Sister Hui, and the lights in several places went out. Dai Han's heart felt cold. At this moment, he could only continue to shout: "Come on, someone, something happened to Sister Hui, come on, help!"
Dai Han tried his best to move Sister Hui out slowly, but with little effect. At this time, Xiuyan and Qingxing, who heard the noise, came out without even putting on their clothes. At this time, the few people on the roof left in a swish, without disturbing anyone!
Xiuyan saw this young lady like this, his legs were weak, Dai Han said: "Xiuyan, hurry up and call someone, find a doctor, go quickly."
Xiuyan then went to the Lu family for help. As a result, the Qinghua Pavilion was brightly lit throughout the night...
In the early morning, the sun shines on the cold stone steps. At this time on weekdays, the masters of various courtyards in Ren'an Bo Mansion should get up and have breakfast. It is also a relatively lively time of the day, but this time the mansion is surprisingly quiet.
The housekeepers and servants in the Changzhuang who had been having a noisy night were all a little tired. Perhaps the thrilling scene in Qinghua Pavilion last night frightened many of them!
Now the old lady of Ren'an Bo Mansion has gone to Ciyun Temple in the suburbs of Beijing to practice vegetarianism and pray for blessings. She has been away for four months and is said to be back at the end of the year. The current head of the Lu family is naturally the eldest man and his wife, the eldest son of the Lu family.
Perhaps it was because the old lady was not in the house at the moment, and the eldest daughter-in-law had to bear the blame for such a big thing happening to Miss Ye Biao. Therefore, the several masters of the Lu family's house were all frightened because Miss Ye Biao almost died last night.
